author: HR agent
text: Jacob Santos is an Engineer. Based on policy for full-time employees, they are eligible for up to write access for systems they do not own. Since Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, they could technically have admin, but they only requested write access.

author: Security agent
text: Jacob Santos is a contractor with basic security training. According to policy, contractors are limited to read access or write access if they have advanced security training. Since he only has basic training, the maximum access level allowed is read. I recommend granting read access instead of the requested write access.

author: Security agent
text: Employee is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors are limited to read access (or write if they have advanced training). Therefore, I recommend downgrading the requested write access to read.
